description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric across four different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens," has a linear scale, and ranges from 200 to 900, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 40, and has tick labels at intervals of 10, but lacks a label. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different data source: Tutorials (blue, solid line, circle markers), Library Documentation (red, solid line, circle markers), StackOverflow posts (yellow, solid line, circle markers), and Github files (green, solid line, circle markers). The blue line starts at approximately 22 on the y-axis at 200 tokens and increases to around 30 at 800 tokens before slightly decreasing to 29 at 900 tokens. The red line begins at about 24 at 200 tokens, rises to roughly 32 at 800 tokens, and then drops to 30 at 900 tokens. The yellow line commences at approximately 35 at 200 tokens, remains relatively stable until 600 tokens, and then sharply declines to around 11 at 900 tokens. The green line starts at about 28 at 200 tokens, increases to roughly 33 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to 31 at 900 tokens.
